title: Inf secondary
script:
--[[
    RPG Exploit - Security Testing
    Target: RPG Explosive Weapon
]]

local function findAndModifyRPG()
    -- Modify config table
    for _, value in pairs(getgc(true)) do
        if type(value) == "table" then
            -- Find RPG config by matching structure
            if rawget(value, "Type") == "Explosive" 
            and rawget(value, "ClipSize") == 1 
            and rawget(value, "ReserveAmmo") == 20 
            and rawget(value, "Weight") == 1.1 then
                
                local cooldowns = rawget(value, "Cooldowns")
                local recoil = rawget(value, "Recoil")
                
                if cooldowns and recoil then
                    -- Infinite ammo
                    rawset(value, "Ammo", 9e9)
                    rawset(value, "ClipSize", 9e9)
                    rawset(value, "ReserveAmmo", 9e9)
                    
                    -- No cooldowns
                    rawset(cooldowns, "Reload", 0)
                    rawset(cooldowns, "Fire", 0)
                    
                    -- No recoil
                    rawset(recoil, "Intensity", 0)
                    rawset(recoil, "Duration", 0)
                    
                    print("[RPG] Config modified successfully")
                end
            end
            
            -- Find RPG instance by matching weapon meta
            local meta = rawget(value, "_weaponMeta")
            if meta and meta.Name == "RPG" and meta.Class == "Explosives" then
                local tool = rawget(value, "_tool")
                
                if tool then
                    -- Infinite ammo on tool
                    tool:SetAttribute("Ammo", 9e9)
                    tool:SetAttribute("ClipSize", 9e9)
                    tool:SetAttribute("ReserveAmmo", 9e9)
                    
                    print("[RPG] Instance modified successfully")
                end
            end
            
            -- Find and bypass cooldown manager
            if rawget(value, "GetAction") and rawget(value, "AddAction") and rawget(value, "Cleanup") then
                rawset(value, "GetAction", function()
                    return nil
                end)
                
                print("[RPG] Cooldown bypass active")
            end
        end
    end
end

findAndModifyRPG()
